Subject: Quick 10-min micro-interview for G2 — written option and $75 e-gift

Hi Sophie —

Hope you’re doing well. I’m putting together a short set of customer spotlights for G2 and Capterra and wanted to invite Brightlane to participate. We can do a 10-minute live micro-interview (Zoom) or, if it’s easier, a very short written Q&A that you can answer asynchronously.

Why we ask: your deployment of Redwood Dedicated has been a great example of predictable throughput at lower cost — it’d be super helpful to capture a few quotes for our product page and listings.

Logistics:
- Format: 10-min Zoom OR written answers to 6 bullet questions (I can send the questions).
- Timing: flexible — happy to work around your weeks.
- Incentive: we offer a $75 e-gift (Tango) or Redwood swag pack — whichever you prefer.
- Publishing: we’ll send the draft review to you before publishing and only post with your permission.

If you’re open, here are quick next steps:
1) Reply with preference (Zoom vs written) and best days/times, or
2) book a 10-min slot: https://cal.com/redwood/10-min-advocacy

I’ve attached a one-pager and a short ask template so you can see the questions and how we quote.

Thanks so much — would love to include Brightlane.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Customer Advocacy Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Quick 10-min micro-interview for G2 — written option and $75 e-gift

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for reaching out and for thinking of Brightlane. We’d love to help, but a couple of constraints on our side:

- Prefer written Q&A over a live call (we can’t commit to a synchronous meeting right now).
- We need to route any marketing quote through our legal/comms team for approval (usually 2–3 business days).
- Regarding incentives: the finance team requires an internal PO or vendor onboarding for gift cards over $50 — can you confirm how Redwood handles fulfillment and whether you need any forms from us?

If you send the questions and a note about fulfillment, I’ll circulate internally and try to get back within 48 hours.

Best,
Sophie Grant
Sr. Manager, Customer Experience
Brightlane

I’m planning to send a short 6-question doc and the fulfillment instructions (I’ll attach both). If Ben can confirm the Tango flow and Marissa can confirm the publish/quote checklist, I’ll respond with the questions and a quick timeline.

Hi Sophie —

Thanks for the quick note — totally understand the constraints. We’re happy to proceed with the written Q&A. A few concrete details:

- Attached are the 6 short questions (g2-questions.txt) and a one-page fulfillment guide (fulfillment-instructions.pdf) that explains options for Tango e-gifts vs Redwood swag.
- We can publish only after you sign off on any quotes. We’ll send the draft review to you for approval within 48 hours of receiving answers.
- Regarding the incentive: we’ll issue a $75 Tango e-gift. Typically we:
  * send the e-gift after you approve the draft, OR
  * if finance requires a PO/vendor form, we can accept a short completed vendor info form from Brightlane (company name, tax ID if requested, billing contact) and queue the Tango for fulfillment upon publication.

If you’re comfortable, please:
1) Reply with the completed answers (inline or attached), and
2) let us know whether you prefer the e-gift or swag, and whether your finance team needs a vendor form.

I’ve attached the questions and the fulfillment instructions for your legal/finance review. Happy to reword any quote language to make approvals easier.

Thanks again — really appreciate Brightlane’s willingness to help.

Warmly,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Customer Advocacy Manager
Redwood Inference
